Counsel for Applicant :- Ramakar Shukla Counsel for Opposite Party :- G.A.
Hon'ble Pankaj Bhatia,J.

1. Heard learned counsel for the applicant as well as learned A.G.A. and perused the record.
2.
The applicant seeks enlargement on bail in FIR No.395 of 2023, under Sections 498A, 304B IPC and Section 3/4 of D.P. Act, Police Station Chanda, District Sultanpur.

3. In terms of the FIR, it was alleged that the daughter of the informant was married to the applicant around 3 years ago, however, she was being harassed and subsequently on 25.09.2023, the daughter had committed suicide by consuming some poisonous substance.
As per the postmortem report, the cause of death could not be ascertained.

sentences.text: 4. The Counsel for the applicant relies upon the statement of the witnesses who have deposed that the deceased had committed suicide after consumption of poisonous substance.
5. Learned A.G.A. vehemently opposed the bail prayer.

6. Considering the fact that prima facie, the deceased had committed suicide coupled with the fact that the applicant has no criminal antecedents and is in custody since 28.09.2023 and there is nothing on record to demonstrate that the applicant if enlarged on bail, would in any way adversely affect the trial, I am of the view that the applicant is entitled to be released on bail.
Accordingly, the bail application is allowed.

7. Let the applicant Saif Ali Khan be released on bail in the abovesaid first information report number on his furnishing personal bonds and two reliable sureties of Rs.20,000/- each to the satisfaction of the court concerned with the following conditions:
(a) The applicant shall execute a bond to undertake to attend the hearings;
(b) The applicant shall not commit any offence similar to the offence of which he is accused or suspected of the commission; and (c) The applicant shall not directly or indirectly make any inducement, threat or promise to any person acquainted with the facts of the case so as to dissuade him from disclosing such facts to the Court or to any police officer or tamper with the evidence.
